[b]Dealings with Daesun[/b]

Hydronia knew that Daesun was going to get involved in the Valdderan war sooner or later. The giant of the east, with whom Hydronia had had a Cold War over the shamat sea for several decades, could never sit around whilst war unfolded on their doorstep. However, involvement so quickly and forcefully was indeed unexpected on Hydronias part. Airdropping troops directly into Vald, which was at this point totally controlled by Hydronian forces, was both a risky move and could be seen by Hydronia as an act of hostility. 

But, Hydronia chose not to see it as this. President Bozkan knew that war with Daesun would only make this situation worse and could have unseen consequences for the people of Valddera. Publicly, Hydronia would remain strong and unwavering on the stance that Hydronia must remain in Vald for now, however behind diplomatic doors, Hydronia would make an offer to Daesun; If Hydronia allowed Daesunite forces to operate in Vald and establish a new government as Daesun pleases, Hydronian forces would be allowed to remain in Vald as peacekeepers and as a deterrent to the ISV. Hydronia would once again stress that the ISV is Hydronias only opponent in this war and that Hydronia will cooperate with whatever the legitimate government of Valddera is at the time.

Daesuns move to occupy and later annex Valdderas islands in the shamat sea was an even riskier move than the airdrop into Vald. This could be seen as a trigger for article 3.1 of the Hydro-Valdderan deal, as well as posing a threat to the security of Hydronias islands; Turnikuz, Samzad and Izib. In response to this blatant land-grabbing by Daesun, Hydronia would further increase its naval and aerial presence across the shamat sea, under the guise of ensuring Hydronian security. Daesuns occupation of these islands now threatened to reignite the naval Cold War between the two nations across the shamat sea. 

Hydronia of course did not want a new Cold War, the EDU was a big enough threat already, Hydronia and THEP did not need Daesun bullying around smaller nations on shamat too. So, Hydronia would make an offer. Hydronia would extend its offered deal in Vald over the shamat sea and the rest of Valddera, by offering to reduce Hydronias naval presence in the shamat sea, if Daesunite forces stayed out of Hydronias occupied zones in mainland Valddera. 

The referendums held on Valdderas shamat sea islands would spark suspicion among the Hydronian government. Privately, President Bozkan would accuse the referendums of being faked, but publicly nothing would be said, as the government did not want to worsen the already tense situation. Hydronia would also offer to buy some of Daesuns newly acquired islands, for a price that could be determined at a later conference.

Whilst the situation with Daesun progressed, for better or worse, Hydronian special forces cobra team would continue their nightly searches for Hassan Al-Amin, the leader of the brutal ISV regime.
